test_save: test the save function to serialize a dict of torch tensors into in-memory bytes
test_save_file: test the save_file function to serialize torch tensors into a .safetensors file on disk
test_load_file: test the load_file function to deserialize a .safetensors file back into a dict of torch tensors
test_safe_open_slice: test the safe_open context manager to stream tensors from a .safetensors file with partial slicing
test_save_with_metadata: test the save_file function to write tensors with custom metadata into a .safetensors file
